d: When you look at the Kailasa temple in Ellora, which was built in the 8th century, you are left with questions. Who built this? How did anybody manage to build this at a time when the only tools available were hammers and chisels? If humans did build this, why is there no solid evidence saying so? Also, where did all the debris go? These questions are answered by theories like aliens built this temple, and that it was built in just a week. But what is the truth?
